title: Performance regression (41% slower) from 0.5.1 to 0.6.0

labels.name: archived due to age
labels.description: This issue has been archived; please open a new issue for any further discussion

body:
Updating eslint from 0.5.1 to 0.6.0 changes linting time from 3.2s (even faster than jsHint's 3.7s!) to about 4.5s.

I have a couple of `.eslintrc` and `.eslintignore` files:
`.eslintrc`:

``` json
{
    "env": {
        "node": true
    },

    "rules": {
        "camelcase": 0,
        "consistent-return": 0,
        "curly": 2,
        "eqeqeq": [2, "smart"],
        "new-cap": 0,
        "no-bitwise": 2,
        "no-caller": 2,
        "no-comma-dangle": 0,
        "no-console": 0,
        "no-empty": 2,
        "no-extend-native": 2,
        "no-extra-strict": 2,
        "no-mixed-requires": 0,
        "no-new": 2,
        "no-redeclare": 0,
        "no-undef": 2,
        "no-unused-vars": 2,
        "no-use-before-define": 0,
        "one-var": 2,
        "quotes": [2, "single"],
        "strict": 2,

        "complexity": 10,
        "max-len": [2, 120, 4]
    }
}
```
